panels.description: Adrian appears in the recording beside a rising waterline. Keep upper projection clear.
Adrian faces the recording lens as water rises behind him. Keep upper projection clear.
Water climbs behind Adrian while his expression remains loving and frightened. Keep upper projection clear.
Adrian reaches toward the projector controls. Keep upper controls clear.

items.speaker: ADRIAN
items.text: Alex. I don’t know whether this reaches you.

items.speaker: ADRIAN
items.text: I wanted to leave you a choice. I left you a burden instead.

items.speaker: ADRIAN
items.text: Do not become me because I failed to be there.
